topic: How do distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs between coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation?
consensus_response: Distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs by necessitating a balance between coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation. Strategies like frequency reuse, orthogonal resource allocation, and beamforming help mitigate interference, while stochastic geometry models optimize resource allocation and predict interference patterns, ensuring efficient constellation performance.
reference_context: Stochastic geometry models and frequency reuse approaches enable accurate analysis and design of dense satellite networks, considering satellite distribution and interference power.
